name: Imanol Schlag

affiliations.role: Researcher, ETH AI Center; Apertus senior author

bio: Imanol Schlag is an AI research scientist at the ETH AI Center and co-lead of Apertus, the open large language model of the Swiss AI Initiative. Their research covers efficient architectures, scaling and generalization. Schlag co-invented DeltaNet in the paper "Linear Transformers are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers".
known_for: Co-lead of the Apertus open LLM
